schema.description: Order object describes an order on Wolt.

venue.description: Details of the venue where the order was placed.

external_venue_id.description: Unique identifier for the venue provided by merchant.

amount.description: Price presented in whole numbers in the lowest denomination, commonly cents. For example 10.00€ would be 1000.

delivery.description: The delivery method of the order.

status.description:
An delivery progresses through a life cycle that consists of different states:

- `estimated`: The time to delivery is estimated by Wolt.
- `drop_off_estimated`: The order drop off time has been estimated.
- `courier_at_venue`: Courier has arrived at the venue to pick up the order.
- `courier_at_delivery_location`: Courier has arrived at the delivery location with the order.
- `picked_up`: The order has been picked up by courier and is on its way to the consumer.
- `delivered`: Courier has completed the delivery.
- `none`: Order is in an undefined status.

type.description:
Type of delivery.

- `takeaway`: An order with this item can be picked up by the consumer from the restaurant or store.
- `homedelivery`: An order with this item can be delivered by a Wolt courier.
- `eatin`: The order can be eaten in the restaurant. This feature has been deprecated at Wolt, so while this delivery method will appear in the menu, it is not supported for consumers.

time.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the order was delivered to the consumer.

fee.description: Delivery fee details. Available only if the merchant and Wolt are operating under a "Delivery sold to merchant" model, otherwise the value is `null`.

amount.description: Price presented in whole numbers in the lowest denomination, commonly cents. For example 10.00€ would be 1000.

location.description: Details for delivery location. Available only for self-delivery venues.

street_address.description: Street address as given to Wolt by the consumer.

apartment.description: Apartment number as given to Wolt by the consumer.

city.description: City name as given to Wolt by the consumer.

zip_code.description: Zip code as given to Wolt by the consumer.

country.description: Country name. Selected automatically from the city name.

coordinates.description: Longitude and Latitude of the pin dropped by the consumer to indicate the location of the address given

lon.description: Longitude of the pin dropped by the consumer to indicate the location of the address given.

lat.description: Latitude of the pin dropped by the consumer to indicate the location of the address given.

formatted_address.description: Formatted representation of an address. Includes basic address details and more detailed information related to address type.

small_order_surcharge.description: If the order size is less than the minimum delivery amount, then a small order surcharge is charged from the consumer. This is available only for delivery sold to venues and self-delivery venues

weight_details.description:
Weight details of a weight based item.

This is relevant only for retail.

weight_in_grams.description: Weight of the item in grams.

requested_count.description:
Quantity of the item requested. Used when the item is priced by weight and sold by piece.

For example: two pieces of watermelon, each piece weighs approximately what is set in `weight_in_grams`.

extra_weight_percentage.description:
Additional percentage of weight allowed when the item is being weighed by the picker in the store.

For example if the initially ordered weight is 500g and the extra weight percentage is 10%, then an additional 10% (550 grams) can be added. Any weight exceeding this cannot be charged to the consumer.
If not set, will be returned as 0.

sku.description:
Unique identifier for the item in the venue's enterprise resource planning (ERP) system.

Wolt's menu editor allows setting a stock keeping unit (sku) for the item. It will be returned as a part of order data to easily map it from Wolt's format to your system.

gtin.description:
Unique identifier for the item in the venue's enterprise resource planning (ERP) system.

Wolt's menu editor allows setting a global trade item number (gtin) for the item. It will be returned as a part of order data to easily map it from Wolt's format to your system.

pos_id.description:
Unique identifier for the item in the venue's POS system.

Wolt's menu editor allows setting a point of sale (POS) ID for the item. It will be returned as a part of order data to easily map it from Wolt's format to your system.

item_type.description:
Type of the item. Item's type is linked to the type of venue.

Restaurant items by default use `order-item` type, while retail stores use `order-retail-item`.

created_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the order was received by Wolt's system.

consumer_comment.description:
Comment added to the order by consumer.

When making an order using Wolt app, a consumer can leave a message to the restaurant. For example to inform the kitchen about dietary restrictions.

pickup_eta.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the courier is expected to pick up the order.

attribution_id.description:
Unique identifier for the attribution.

This is used to track consumer "source" if the consumer is coming to Wolt from a merchant's website or app. Merchants can create a unique attribution IDs for a campaign or source and pass it to Wolt. This ID is carried through the order flow and reflected in the order.

type.description:
An order can be of two different types.

- `instant`: When an order is to be fulfilled instantly.
- `preorder`: When a consumer schedules an order.

preorder_time.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the pre-order should be delivered.

pre_order_status.description:
An pre-order progresses through a life cycle that consists of different states:

- `waiting`: The pre-order is waiting to be confirmed by the venue.
- `confirmed`: The pre-order was seen by the venue and has been confirmed.

consumer_name.description:
Name of the consumer who made the order.

If a self-delivery venue has full name setting enabled they will receive the full name of the consumer, otherwise the name will include only first name and first letter of last name.

consumer_phone_number.description:
Phone number of the consumer who made the order.

Consumer phone number is not shared unless absolutely necessary. This is toggled on only for select markets where the phone number is available on the Wolt Merchant app or for self-delivery venues. The field is null in all other cases.

order_number.description: A human readable order number that is unique only for open orders. Order numbers can repeat and are not unique for a venue.

order_status.description:
Status of the order. An order progresses through a life cycle that consists of different states:

- `received`: The order was fetched by the Wolt Merchant app and/or acknowledged by venue staff on the app.
- `fetched`: The order was fetched in the Wolt Merchant app.
- `acknowledged`: The order was interacted by venue staff on the Wolt Merchant app.
- `production`: Preparation of the order has started.
- `ready`: The order has been prepared and is awaiting delivery.
- `delivered`: The order has been delivered to the consumer.
- `rejected`: The venue or Wolt's system rejected the order.
- `refunded`: Wolt has processed a refund for the order.
- `other`: Other unknown status.

modified_at.description:
The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the order was last modified.

Orders move through a life cycle and can change the order status. This change is also considered a modification, so the date and time could be the time when a purchase changed its status from `acknowledged` to `production`.

company_tax_id.description:
Unique identifier for company tax.

In some markets, consumers are allowed to bill their company for the purchase. In these situations they input the company's tax ID and this information is passed on for accounting purposes.

loyalty_card_number.description:
Loyalty card number given by consumer during checkout from a retail venue.

This can be only used to add points for the consumer based on the purchase. No validation of this number takes place in Wolt's system.

is_wolt_plus.description:
This field indicates whether the order was a Wolt+ order or not.
The presence of this field depends on the venue configuration.

is_no_contact_delivery.description: For self delivery orders, this field being "true" indicates that the user has asked for the drop off to be to their "doorstep" without an interaction with the courier delivering.

cash_payment.description:
Contains information about cash payment of the order.

With this information the courier will be able to request correct amount of cash from the customer 
and also reserve enough change in case customer does not have even amount in cash.

cash_amount.description: The amount of cash the restaurant will earn on this purchase, can be lower than the total if e.g.: FTU credits are used.

amount.description: Price presented in whole numbers in the lowest denomination, commonly cents. For example 10.00€ would be 1000.

cash_to_expect.description: The cash amount that will be given by the consumer to the courier. It allows the courier to have change available.

amount.description: Price presented in whole numbers in the lowest denomination, commonly cents. For example 10.00€ would be 1000.

order_handling.description: With this information you are able to trigger specific flows on your middleware for order handling - acceptance, delay for preparation and forecasted preparation time.

preparation_time.description: Information of preparation time and delays used by this venue for this specific purchase, based on venue’s configuration on Wolt systems.

preparation_time_seconds.description: Amount of time (in seconds) needed for the venue to prepare this order, according to the “source” used. Note that this refers to the expected time between order acceptance until it is ready to be picked up; actual pickup ETA is impacted by other factors.

preparation_time_source.description:
- `venue_default`:           venue-specific preparation time
- `venue_config_schedule`:   venue-specific schedule-based preparation time
- `venue_config_order_size`: venue-specific order size-based preparation time
- `adjusted_by_venue`:       venue sent "adjustedPickupTime" within the body of the request to accept, and it was used, or venue used Wolt's merchant app to override the suggested time
- `forecasted_by_wolt`:      preparation time was forecasted by Wolt's model
- `system_default`:          fallback value was used

acceptance_status.description:
- `to_be_accepted_by_venue`: venue is not subscribed to Wolt's auto-accept, order should be accepted by an "accept" call (or manually via Wolt's merchant app)
- `to_be_accepted_by_wolt`:  venue is subscribed to Wolt's auto-accept, order was still not accepted automatically, but will be (a pre-order's acceptance will be delayed, naturally). A separate "accept" request is not required
- `accepted_by_venue`:       order was accepted by venue by an "accept" request (or manually via Wolt's merchant app)
- `auto_accepted_by_wolt`:   order was auto accepted by Wolt systems
- `other`:                   value for orders rejected before acceptance etc.

courier_arrival.description:
- `subscribed_to_notification`: venue is subscribed to Wolt's courier arrival notifications
- `notification_sent`:          the courier arrival notification was sent    
- `other`:                      value for takeaway orders, self-delivery orders, orders of venues not subscribed to notifications.

in_store_operations.description:
Contains information about in-store operations required as a part of handling this order.

This will be used in cases where venue staff need to perform certain additional tasks as a part of processing a purchase.

total_balance_to_pay_in_venue.description: The balance to be paid in the venue upon pickup. It does not make any assumptions of the payment method used to settle the remaining balance in-store. This field is currently limited to Storefront venues only.

If you are not sure how this applies to you, check with the local accounting representative for your merchant customer or with your Wolt contact.

type.description:

Status of the order. An order progresses through a life cycle that consists of different states:

- `acknowledged`: The order was interacted by venue staff on the Wolt Merchant app.

- `delivered`: The order has been delivered to the consumer.

company_tax_id.description:
Unique identifier for company (billing and tax purposes).

In some markets, consumers are allowed to bill their company for the purchase. In these situations they can input the company's tax ID. This information can be passed on for accounting purposes (generating an invoice). Note: This field being a non-null does not mandate company_address and company_name to be non-null.

company_name.description:
Name of company (billing and tax purposes).

In some markets, consumers are allowed to bill their company for the purchase. In these situations they can input the company's tax ID, with potentially also the name and the address of the company. This information can be passed on for accounting purposes (generating an invoice).

company_address.description:
Address for company (billing and tax purposes).

In some markets, consumers are allowed to bill their company for the purchase. In these situations they can input the company's tax ID, with potentially also the name and the address of the company. This information can be passed on for accounting purposes (generating an invoice).

row_number.description:
Position of the item in the order. The row number is available in the get order response for reference.

The value must not repeat in the request.

replacement_items.description: Replacements for the item. For example substituting item with another, changes to weight or items missing.

replacement_type.description:
The type of replacement that was made - items can be missing, substituted, or could have different weights than originally ordered.

  - `count-change-replacement`: Items missing.
  - `menu-item-replacement`: Item was substituted with another one.
  - `weight-change-replacement`: Item's weight is different from what was ordered by the consumer.
  - `adhoc-replacement`: Item was substituted with another one due to unexpected issues.
  - `reduced-price`: Item’s price was reduced due to a promotion in the store, after purchase was made (eg loyalty plan pricing etc). `name` is optional — if omitted, it is resolved from the `barcode`.

barcode.description:
Barcode of the item.

- Required for `menu-item-replacement`.
- Required for `reduced-price` when `name` is omitted (used to resolve the item name).
- Optional for other replacement types.

count.description:
Number of items picked.

For example if an item is missing and it can't be substituted then 0 is count that is being picked.

name.description:
Name of the item as it should appear on the consumer's receipt.

- Required for `adhoc-replacement` (item not in menu, no barcode lookup possible).
- Optional for `reduced-price`: if omitted, the name is resolved from the barcode.
- Optional for `menu-item-replacement`: if omitted, the name is resolved from the barcode.

price.description:
The item price to use.

- For `menu-item-replacement` and `adhoc-replacement`: price of the substitute item.
- For `reduced-price`: the new reduced price of the original item.

amount.description: Price presented in whole numbers in the lowest denomination, commonly cents. For example 10.00€ would be 1000.

purchase_item_id.description: Unique identifier for the item in the purchase.

weight.description:
Actual weight picked in grams for the **same item** (weight adjustment).

**Applicable to:**
- `weight-change-replacement`: Adjust weight of the same item

Use this when the ordered item's weight differs from what was picked (e.g., ordered 1kg, only 500g available).
This is different from `picked_weight` which is used when substituting with a different weighted item.

picked_weight.description:
Actual weight picked in grams for weighted item **substitutions**.

**Applicable to:**
- `menu-item-replacement`: Substitute with a weighted menu item
- `adhoc-replacement`: Substitute with a weighted non-menu item

Use this when **substituting** an item with a weighted item.
This is different from `weight` which adjusts the weight of the same item.

Requires `weighted_item_input_type` to be specified.

weighted_item_input_type.description:
Specifies how to interpret the `picked_weight` value in relation to the `count` field for weighted substitutions.

**Note:** `picked_weight` always represents the actual picked weight in grams, regardless of this type.

**Applicable to:**
- `menu-item-replacement`: Substitute with a weighted menu item
- `adhoc-replacement`: Substitute with a weighted non-menu item

**Values:**
- `grams`: The `picked_weight` is the total weight in grams. Typically used with `count: 1`.
- `number_of_items`: The `picked_weight` is the total weight in grams for all items. The `count` field specifies the number of weighted units (e.g., count: 2 with picked_weight: 1000 means 2 items totaling 1000g).

Required when `picked_weight` is provided.

items.title: ItemReplacement

items.description:
**AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST ONLY**

Add a free or promotional item to the order without replacing existing items. Free items are always added at price 0.

**Item identification:** Items can be identified in two ways (following the same pattern as `replacement_items`):
- **Menu item (by barcode):** Provide `barcode` only. PIS will look up the item in the venue's menu
  and automatically enrich with the item ID before forwarding to RAPI.
- **Adhoc item (by name):** Provide `name` (no barcode). The item will be added as a custom item
  not from the menu, with price set to 0.

**Use cases:**
- Adding promotional or free items from the venue's menu
- Adding custom compensation items
- Adding free items related to specific order line items (use `row_number` to link)

{% callout variant="warning" %}
Contact Wolt support to request access.
{% /callout %}

barcode.description:
Barcode/GTIN of the menu item to add (for menu items).

When provided, PIS will look up the item in the venue's menu by barcode and automatically
enrich the request with the item ID before forwarding to RAPI.

If the barcode is not found in the menu, the request will fail with an error.

**Menu item addition:** Use this field alone (without `name`).
**Adhoc addition:** Leave this field null and provide `name` instead.

name.description:
Item name for adhoc (non-menu) additions.

Required when `barcode` is null. Ignored when `barcode` is provided.

**Adhoc addition:** Use this field (without `barcode`).

row_number.description:
Optional reference to an existing order item's row number.

Use this to indicate that the free item is related to a specific order line item.
This helps operations tools show why the item was added as free (e.g., "free drink
with meal from row 0").

The row number is available in the get order response for reference.

vat_percentage.description: VAT percentage for the deposit. Typically the same as the VAT percentage of the item being sold.

row_number.description: Position of the item in the order. Only returned for retail item types.

is_allowed.description: Whether the item consumer selected can be substituted with a similar item of the same or lower price.

comment.description:
The customer's request for a substitution, in the case this item is not available for their order.
This string can describe an alternative item or another form of free request, that should be visible to the person picking (or preparing) the order in the store.

weight_in_grams.description: Weight of the item in grams.

requested_count.description:
Quantity of the item requested. Used when the item is priced by weight and sold by piece.

For example: two pieces of watermelon, each piece weighs approximately what is set in `weight_in_grams`.

extra_weight_percentage.description:
Additional percentage of weight allowed when the item is being weighed by the picker in the store.

For example if the initially ordered weight is 500g and the extra weight percentage is 10%, then an additional 10% (550 grams) can be added. Any weight exceeding this cannot be charged to the consumer.
If not set, will be returned as 0.

created_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the order was received by Wolt's system.

consumer_comment.description:
Comment added to the order by consumer.

When making an order using Wolt app, a consumer can leave a message to the restaurant. For example to inform the kitchen about dietary restrictions.

consumer_name.description:
Name of the consumer who made the order.

If a self-delivery venue has full name setting enabled they will receive the full name of the consumer, otherwise the name will include only first name and first letter of last name.

consumer_phone_number.description:
Phone number of the consumer who made the order.

Consumer phone number is not shared unless absolutely necessary. This is toggled on only for select markets where the phone number is available on the Wolt Merchant app or for self-delivery venues. The field is null in all other cases.

pickup_eta.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the courier is expected to pick up the order.

attribution_id.description:
Unique identifier for the attribution.

This is used to track consumer "source" if the consumer is coming to Wolt from a merchant's website or app. Merchants can create a unique attribution IDs for a campaign or source and pass it to Wolt. This ID is carried through the order flow and reflected in the order.

type.description:
An order can be of two different types.

- `instant`: When an order is to be fulfilled instantly.
- `preorder`: When a consumer schedules an order.

preorder_time.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the pre-order should be delivered.

pre_order_status.description:
An pre-order progresses through a life cycle that consists of different states:

- `waiting`: The pre-order is waiting to be confirmed by the venue.
- `confirmed`: The pre-order was seen by the venue and has been confirmed.

order_number.description: A human readable order number that is unique only for open orders. Order numbers can repeat and are not unique for a venue.

order_status.description:
Status of the order. An order progresses through a life cycle that consists of different states:

- `received`: The order was fetched by the Wolt Merchant app and/or acknowledged by venue staff on the app.
- `fetched`: The order was fetched in the Wolt Merchant app.
- `acknowledged`: The order was interacted by venue staff on the Wolt Merchant app.
- `production`: Preparation of the order has started.
- `ready`: The order has been prepared and is awaiting delivery.
- `delivered`: The order has been delivered to the consumer.
- `rejected`: The venue or Wolt's system rejected the order.
- `other`: Other unknown status.

company_tax_id.description:
Unique identifier for company (billing and tax purposes).

In some markets, consumers are allowed to bill their company for the purchase. In these situations they can input the company's tax ID. This information can be passed on for accounting purposes (generating an invoice). Note: This field being a non-null does not mandate company_address and company_name to be non-null.

company_name.description:
Name of company (billing and tax purposes).

In some markets, consumers are allowed to bill their company for the purchase. In these situations they can input the company's tax ID, with potentially also the name and the address of the company. This information can be passed on for accounting purposes (generating an invoice).

company_address.description:
Address for company (billing and tax purposes).

In some markets, consumers are allowed to bill their company for the purchase. In these situations they can input the company's tax ID, with potentially also the name and the address of the company. This information can be passed on for accounting purposes (generating an invoice).

loyalty_card_number.description:
Loyalty card number given by consumer during checkout from a retail venue.

This can be only used to add points for the consumer based on the purchase. No validation of this number takes place in Wolt's system.

is_wolt_plus.description:
This field indicates whether the order was a Wolt+ order or not.
The presence of this field depends on the venue configuration

is_no_contact_delivery.description: For self delivery orders, this field being "true" indicates that the user has asked for the drop off to be to their "doorstep" without an interaction with the courier delivering.

cash_payment.description:
Contains information about cash payment of the order.

With this information the courier will be able to request correct amount of cash from the customer 
and also reserve enough change in case customer does not have even amount in cash.

cash_amount.description: The amount of cash the restaurant will earn on this purchase, can be lower than the total if e.g.: FTU credits are used.

amount.description: Price presented in whole numbers in the lowest denomination, commonly cents. For example 10.00€ would be 1000.

cash_to_expect.description: The cash amount that will be given by the consumer to the courier. It allows the courier to have change available.

amount.description: Price presented in whole numbers in the lowest denomination, commonly cents. For example 10.00€ would be 1000.

total_paid_by_other_methods.description: Indicates the total amount already paid by methods other than cash.

amount.description: Price presented in whole numbers in the lowest denomination, commonly cents. For example 10.00€ would be 1000.

group_participants.description: List of participants for a group order.

items.description: Represents a participant in a group order.

payment.description: Payment information for a group order participant.

method.description: Payment method used by the participant.

items.description: List of items selected by the participant.
Represents an item selected by a participant.

row.description: Row number of the item in the order.

count.description: Number of units of this item selected by the participant.

items.title: GroupParticipantItem
GroupParticipant

order_handling.description: With this information you are able to trigger specific flows on your middleware for order handling - acceptance, delay for preparation and forecasted preparation time.

preparation_time.description: Information of preparation time and delays used by this venue for this specific purchase, based on venue’s configuration on Wolt systems.

preparation_time_seconds.description: Amount of time (in seconds) needed for the venue to prepare this order, according to the “source” used. Note that this refers to the expected time between order acceptance until it is ready to be picked up; actual pickup ETA is impacted by other factors.

preparation_time_source.description:
- `venue_default`:           venue-specific preparation time
- `venue_config_schedule`:   venue-specific schedule-based preparation time
- `venue_config_order_size`: venue-specific order size-based preparation time
- `adjusted_by_venue`:       venue sent "adjustedPickupTime" within the body of the request to accept, and it was used, or venue used Wolt's merchant app to override the suggested time
- `forecasted_by_wolt`:      preparation time was forecasted by Wolt's model
- `system_default`:          fallback value was used

acceptance_status.description:
- `to_be_accepted_by_venue`: venue is not subscribed to Wolt's auto-accept, order should be accepted by an "accept" call (or manually via Wolt's merchant app)
- `to_be_accepted_by_wolt`:  venue is subscribed to Wolt's auto-accept, order was still not accepted automatically, but will be (a pre-order's acceptance will be delayed, naturally). A separate "accept" request is not required
- `accepted_by_venue`:       order was accepted by venue by an "accept" request (or manually via Wolt's merchant app)
- `auto_accepted_by_wolt`:   order was auto accepted by Wolt systems
- `other`:                   value for orders rejected before acceptance etc.

courier_arrival.description:
- `subscribed_to_notification`: venue is subscribed to Wolt's courier arrival notifications
- `notification_sent`:          the courier arrival notification was sent    
- `other`:                      value for takeaway orders, self-delivery orders, orders of venues not subscribed to notifications.

in_store_operations.description:
Contains information about in-store operations required as a part of handling this order.

This will be used in cases where venue staff need to perform certain additional tasks as a part of processing a purchase.

total_balance_to_pay_in_venue.description: The balance to be paid in the venue upon pickup. It does not make any assumptions of the payment method used to settle the remaining balance in-store. This field is currently limited to Storefront venues only.

amount.description: Price presented in whole numbers in the lowest denomination, commonly cents. For example 10.00€ would be 1000.

campaigns_applied.description:
List of venue campaigns that were applied to the order. Only campaigns
sponsored (fully or partially) by the merchant are exposed.

- **Non-empty array**: applied campaigns.
- **Empty array (`[]`)**: no campaigns to expose for this order (none applied or all sponsored by Wolt).
- **`null`**: campaign information could not be resolved for this order (transient, retriable).

items.description: A venue campaign that was applied to the order.

campaign_id.description: Unique identifier of the venue campaign.

campaign_version.description: Version of the campaign at the time the order was placed.

campaign_name.description: Display name of the campaign. `null` when not set.

campaign_external_id.description:
Optional merchant-defined external identifier for the campaign (e.g. a
promotion code from the merchant's own system). `null` when not set.

campaign_type.description:
Type of the campaign. Currently `"discount"`. Treat as an
extensible string — more values may be added.

is_loyalty_conditioned.description: Whether the campaign requires loyalty enrollment to be applied.

items.description:
Per-row discount allocation. One entry per affected basket row.
Empty for delivery discounts.
Discount allocation for a single basket row of a campaign.

row_number.description: Row number of the affected item in the order.

count.description: Number of units of this row that the discount applies to.

total_discount.description: Sum of the discount applied for the item(s) for the specific campaign.

amount.description: Price presented in whole numbers in the lowest denomination, commonly cents. For example 10.00€ would be 1000.
